title: A 33-dimensional code correcting one error on 11 qubits
source: Anglès Munné and Huber record a gap at eleven qubits and distance three in Section~4.2, Table~1. The target rank is the smallest one above the known construction \sourcecite{ref:ec33-amh}{AMH26}.
progress: The known lower bound on the maximum code dimension is $32$, and the rational certificate in Table~1 gives an unrestricted upper bound of $42$. The pure-code bound in Eq.~(40) of the same paper is $41$ \sourcecite{ref:ec33-roj}{ROJ19}, \sourcecite{ref:ec33-amh}{AMH26}. Stabilizer code dimensions are powers of two. Together with the upper bound, this makes dimension $32$ optimal among stabilizer codes. Any larger exact code contains a subcode of rank $33$ satisfying Eq.~\eqref{eq:ec33-detection}.
